instruction.text: Oscar has thought of a suitable search for his homework. Enter the search tree species in the UK into the search bar.
instruction.sound: Oscar has thought of a suitable search for his homework. Enter the search 'tree species in the UK' into the search bar.

instruction.text: Oscar thinks the Woodland Trust is a good source. Select the correct <t-blue>link</t-blue> to open the Woodland Trust’s website.

hint.text: A source is somewhere you can get information from. Official websites are good sources because the information is more likely to have been fact-checked.
hint.label: Source

objects.sound: This website is not the woodland trust’s website

atoms.a: The first website is not a good option because ...
b: ++the website description is about forest bathing.
it is about forests outside of the UK.
not be useful for Oscar’s research.

feedback.end: The first websites are not always the most suitable for searching for specific information. It is best to read the short description before clicking on a website.

atoms.a: The first website is an advert.

feedback.end: In search results, promoted websites are marked with the word sponsored.

atoms.a: The last website is a government website.

feedback.end: Websites with gov.uk are owned by the UK government.

instruction.text: Here is a website with some information about tree species in the UK. Select the grey box.

feedback.end: The sidebar menu is missing here. In the sidebar menu, there are usually links to further information.

instruction.text: Select the most suitable sidebar menu.

atoms.a: The right menu is less suitable because...
b: ++the articles are not related to the topic of the website.
the links are in the wrong order
atoms.sound: The right side menu is less suitable because the articles are not related to the topic of the website.

instruction.text: The website is now complete. Select the advertisement on the website.

atoms.text: Correct. This box was a <t-blue>link</t-blue> with an advertisement for a dental practice. Clicking on it will take you to their website. When doing research, you should try not to be distracted by advertising.
